"""Collect trie baseline results into r16_trie_baseline_results.json."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

OUTDIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs")
CONFIGS = {
    "qwen_ft": "r16_trie_qwen_ft_violations.json",
    "qwen_zs": "r16_trie_qwen_zs_violations.json",
    "llama_ft": "r16_trie_llama_ft_violations.json",
    "llama_zs": "r16_trie_llama_zs_violations.json",
}

ENTITY_TYPES = ["Task", "Method", "Material", "Metric", "OtherScientificTerm", "Generic"]
RELATION_TYPES = ["Used-for", "Feature-of", "Hyponym-of", "Part-of",
                  "Compare", "Conjunction", "Evaluate-for"]

results = {"configs": {}, "trie_construction": {
    "entity_types": ENTITY_TYPES,
    "relation_types": RELATION_TYPES,
}}

for config_name, filename in CONFIGS.items():
    path = OUTDIR / filename
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"MISSING: {path}")
        continue

    with open(path) as f:
        report = json.load(f)

    s = report["summary"]
    q = report["quality"]

    dr_pct = round(s.get("domain_range_violation_rate", 0) * 100, 2)
    cf_pct = round(s.get("cross_field_consistency_violation_rate", 0) * 100, 2)
    et_pct = round(s.get("entity_type_violation_rate", 0) * 100, 2)
    rv_pct = round(s.get("relation_vocabulary_violation_rate", 0) * 100, 2)
    r_f1 = round(q["relation_f1"]["f1"] * 100, 2)
    e_f1 = round(q["entity_f1"]["f1"] * 100, 2)

    json_fail = s.get("json_parse_failure_rate", 0)
    json_fail_pct = round(json_fail * 100, 2) if json_fail <= 1 else round(json_fail, 2)

    results["configs"][config_name] = {
        "DR": dr_pct, "CF": cf_pct, "ET": et_pct, "RV": rv_pct,
        "R_F1": r_f1, "E_F1": e_f1, "JSON_fail": json_fail_pct,
        "total_samples": s.get("total_samples", 0),
        "total_entities": s.get("total_predicted_entities", 0),
        "total_relations": s.get("total_predicted_relations", 0),
    }
    print(f"{config_name}: DR={dr_pct}% ET={et_pct}% RV={rv_pct}% CF={cf_pct}% "
          f"R-F1={r_f1}% E-F1={e_f1}% JSON_fail={json_fail_pct}%")

out_path = OUTDIR / "r16_trie_baseline_results.json"
with open(out_path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(f"\nResults written to {out_path}")
PYTHON_EOF
echo "collect script written"
